act1_intro.speaker: narrator
act1_intro.text: Bunker 4. The sky outside is lethal. The old satellites are going dark one by one.

act1_intro.speaker: ceres
act1_intro.text: Good morning. I am CERES. You four are humanity's mission team now.

m1_1_brief.speaker: navigator
m1_1_brief.text: Before we launch anything, we need a pad and a ground station.

m1_2_brief.speaker: ceres
m1_2_brief.text: We need numbers, not guesses. How much UV is reaching the ground?

m1_2_brief.speaker: scientist
m1_2_brief.text: A UV sensor on a CubeSat could map the damage in days.

m1_2_brief.speaker: engineer
m1_2_brief.text: Then we build it small. Every gram costs fuel.

m1_2_success.speaker: ceres
m1_2_success.text: Signal received. The damage is global. The ozone meter is live.

m1_2_fail.speaker: ceres
m1_2_fail.text: Signal lost. Read the report: the reason is always in the numbers.
